Omnilogue

**Your AI coding history, in one place.** Search and revisit sessions already on your machine, from Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and more. Omnilogue is an open-source desktop app with an optional self-hosted WebUI. [Download](https://github.com/jhlee0409/omnilogue/releases/latest) · [Website and screenshots](https://jhlee0409.github.io/omnilogue/) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) [English](README.md) · [한국어](README.ko.md) · [日本語](README.ja.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md) ![Omnilogue showing a sample conversation, project sidebar, tool calls, and message outline](docs/assets/transcript.webp) ## Installation [Choose a desktop download](https://jhlee0409.github.io/omnilogue/#downloads) for **macOS** (Apple silicon and Intel), **Windows** (x64), or **Linux** (x86-64). Existing installs can update in place and keep their favorites and settings. On macOS, you can also install with [Homebrew](docs/HOMEBREW.md): ```sh brew install --cask jhlee0409/tap/omnilogue ``` For Flatpak and other Linux packages, see the [Linux guide](LINUX_BUILD.md#flatpak). **Other assistants:** startup scans Claude Code only. To load Codex CLI, OpenCode, and the other supported assistants, open the sidebar **Sort and filter** menu and choose **Find other providers** (the empty screen offers the same button). The providers it finds are loaded on every later start. On Windows, **Settings → WSL History Scanning** reads Claude Code and GitHub Copilot history inside WSL; for other assistants inside WSL (such as Codex CLI), run `cchv-server --serve` inside WSL and use the WebUI. ## Features - **Find a conversation again.** Browse by project or assistant and search across sessions. - **Review what happened.** Follow conversation branches, jump between steps, and inspect tool calls and file edits. - **Understand usage.** Review tokens and estimated API costs where the logs provide enough data, with separate visibility into subagent work. - **Keep history local.** The desktop app reads conversation files on disk; it does not upload session data or require an Omnilogue account.
Supported assistants and history sources Aider, Amazon Q CLI, Antigravity, Claude Code, claude.ai account exports, Cline (including Roo Code), CodeBuddy Code, Codex CLI, Continue.dev, Crush, Cursor (including Cursor Agent and Cursor ACP), ForgeCode, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, Goose, Grok CLI, Hermes Agent, Kilo Code, Kimi, Kiro, llm, Mistral Vibe, oh-my-pi, Open Interpreter, OpenCode, OpenHands, PearAI, Pi, Qoder, Qwen Code, Trae, Z Code, and Zed.
## Server Mode (WebUI) Want to use a browser? Run the optional server on your own machine. This example binds it to loopback only: ```sh brew install jhlee0409/tap/cchv-server cchv-server --serve --host 127.0.0.1 ``` Open `http://127.0.0.1:3727`. See the [server guide](docs/server-guide.md) for prebuilt binaries, Docker, and authentication for network access. ## Build from Source Requires Node.js 20.19+ (or 22.12+), pnpm, and a stable Rust toolchain. On Linux, see the [build prerequisites](LINUX_BUILD.md). ```sh git clone https://github.com/jhlee0409/omnilogue.git cd omnilogue pnpm install pnpm tauri:dev ``` Run `pnpm tauri:build` to create a desktop bundle. ## Project links [Session Board guide](docs/USER_GUIDE.md) · [Report an issue](https://github.com/jhlee0409/omnilogue/issues) · [MIT License](LICENSE) Omnilogue is an independent project and is not affiliated with the assistants whose history it reads.

Omnilogue

**你的 AI 编程记录，集中一处。** 搜索并回看设备上已有的 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Cursor、GitHub Copilot 等工具的会话。Omnilogue 是开源桌面应用，也提供可选的自托管 WebUI。 [下载](https://github.com/jhlee0409/omnilogue/releases/latest) · [官网与截图](https://jhlee0409.github.io/omnilogue/?lang=zh-CN) · [更新日志](CHANGELOG.md) [English](README.md) · [한국어](README.ko.md) · [日本語](README.ja.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md) ![Omnilogue 界面展示示例对话、项目侧栏、工具调用和消息目录](docs/assets/transcript.webp) ## 安装 为 **macOS**（Apple 芯片和 Intel）、**Windows**（x64）或 **Linux**（x86-64）[选择桌面安装包](https://jhlee0409.github.io/omnilogue/?lang=zh-CN#downloads)。已安装的用户可以直接更新，保留收藏和设置。 macOS 也可通过 [Homebrew](docs/HOMEBREW.md) 安装： ```sh brew install --cask jhlee0409/tap/omnilogue ``` Flatpak 和其他 Linux 安装包见 [Linux 指南](LINUX_BUILD.md#flatpak)。 **其他助手：** 启动时只扫描 Claude Code。要加载 Codex CLI、OpenCode 等其他受支持的助手，请打开侧边栏的 **排序和筛选** 菜单并选择 **查找其他提供商**（空白界面也提供同一按钮）。找到的提供商会在之后每次启动时自动加载。在 Windows 上，**设置 → WSL 历史扫描** 会读取 WSL 发行版中的 Claude Code 和 GitHub Copilot 历史。对于 WSL 中的其他助手（如 Codex CLI），请在 WSL 中运行 `cchv-server --serve` 并使用 WebUI。 ## 核心功能 - **找回需要的对话。** 按项目或工具浏览记录，跨会话搜索。 - **回顾工作过程。** 沿着对话分支回看，在步骤间跳转，检查工具调用和文件修改。 - **了解用量。** 日志信息充分时，可查看词元用量和预估 API 费用，也能单独查看子代理的活动。 - **记录保留在本地。** 桌面应用直接读取本地会话文件，不上传记录，也不要求注册 Omnilogue 账号。
支持的工具和记录来源 Aider、Amazon Q CLI、Antigravity、Claude Code、claude.ai 账号导出、Cline（含 Roo Code）、CodeBuddy Code、Codex CLI、Continue.dev、Crush、Cursor（含 Cursor Agent 和 Cursor ACP）、ForgeCode、Gemini CLI、GitHub Copilot、Goose、Grok CLI、Hermes Agent、Kilo Code、Kimi、Kiro、llm、Mistral Vibe、oh-my-pi、Open Interpreter、OpenCode、OpenHands、PearAI、Pi、Qoder、Qwen Code、Trae、Z Code 和 Zed。
## 服务器模式（WebUI） 如果希望通过浏览器查看，请在自己的设备上运行服务器。以下示例仅允许本机访问： ```sh brew install jhlee0409/tap/cchv-server cchv-server --serve --host 127.0.0.1 ``` 打开 `http://127.0.0.1:3727`。预编译程序、Docker 和网络访问认证请参考[服务器指南](docs/server-guide.md)。 ## 从源码构建 需要 Node.js 20.19+（或 22.12+）、pnpm 和稳定版 Rust 工具链。Linux 用户请查看[构建要求](LINUX_BUILD.md)。 ```sh git clone https://github.com/jhlee0409/omnilogue.git cd omnilogue pnpm install pnpm tauri:dev ``` 运行 `pnpm tauri:build` 可打包桌面应用。 ## 项目链接 [会话看板指南](docs/USER_GUIDE.md) · [报告问题](https://github.com/jhlee0409/omnilogue/issues) · [MIT 许可证](LICENSE) Omnilogue 是独立项目，与这些工具的提供方没有隶属或合作关系。
